title: Candidate C2 Active-Set Re-equilibration Diagnostic (PBS 1416328.mmaster02)
finding: Developed and qualified Kuhn-Tucker active-set formulation for unilateral damage irreversibility (d_receiver >= d_mapped) on Candidate C2 (2,300 quads, h=1.0 um) under frozen UEL f42_mixed_uel.for. Analyzed Package 78 telemetry: Step 2 reaction forces RF3 match Lagrange multipliers lambda_i = (K_phi d - F_phi^ext)_i; crack-tip nodes (Node 1192, lambda = -4.63e-5) have negative multipliers confirming driving force exceeds resistance, while 1,756 far-field and flank nodes have positive multipliers (lambda > 0) predicting 87.5% (1508/1724) of healing onset. Formulated Package 79 active-set deck: Step 1 injects state, Step 2 relaxes mechanical residual under frozen damage, Step 3 enforces active equality constraints (d = d_mapped) only on the 1,756 active nodes while leaving 657 inactive crack-tip/opening nodes free to advance damage under dt_min = 1e-12. Verified Abaqus 2023 cluster datacheck PASS (Exit 0) and submitted qualified diagnostic PBS 1416328.mmaster02.
